corrected_implementation: scripts/task110_lib.py (crossover rules, cost port, estimators, derivatives, regimes)

findings.existing_behavior: prev_above is initialized by inverting the first valid MA relationship, manufacturing a BUY or SELL on the first valid MA row without a real crossover
findings.why_it_matters: creates a phantom first trade per symbol and pollutes every downstream statistic
findings.correct_behavior: no signal until two consecutive valid MA observations; Golden: prev<=cur30_prev & cur7>cur30; Death: prev>=prev30 & cur7<cur30; equality handled as relationship 0

findings.existing_behavior: trades execute at the same close that produced the crossover
findings.why_it_matters: same-close execution is look-ahead: no decision process can act on a close in the same instant it prints; inflates returns
findings.correct_behavior: signal generated after completed daily bar; hypothetical fill at the NEXT valid session's open; unfilled signals are never fabricated
findings.fixed_in: run_portfolio() in scripts/task110_phases_research.py; executeAtNextOpen() in golden-cross.ts

findings.existing_behavior: Var_GK multiplied by 252 in the estimator and sqrt(Var_GK*252) again in the plot — annualization applied twice
findings.why_it_matters: annualized volatility overstated by sqrt(252) ≈ 15.9x; invalidates regime thresholds
findings.correct_behavior: annualize exactly once: Var_ann = 252 x daily variance; vol = sqrt(Var_ann)

findings.existing_behavior: annualization conventions inconsistent with GK (task requires each estimator annualized exactly once)
findings.why_it_matters: mixed units make cross-estimator comparison meaningless
findings.correct_behavior: all three estimators return daily variance; x252 applied once at the annualized layer

findings.existing_behavior: negative GK estimates silently clipped away
findings.why_it_matters: hides data/assumption diagnostics; sqrt of negative would be silently avoided instead of reported
findings.correct_behavior: negatives kept in research series, counted, exemplified; vol reported unavailable where sqrt undefined

findings.existing_behavior: no validation of O/H/L/C before logarithms (zero/negative prices, high<low)
findings.why_it_matters: log of non-positive raises or silently poisons windows; h<l makes range estimators meaningless
findings.correct_behavior: bars validated (o,h,l,c>0 and h>=l); invalid bars excluded from windows and counted

findings.existing_behavior: first/second derivatives computed across missing sessions as if spacing were regular
findings.why_it_matters: a gap of k sessions is treated like one period; derivatives systematically biased around gaps
findings.correct_behavior: differences only across global-calendar-adjacent observations; None + gap flag otherwise

findings.existing_behavior: BBW acceleration annotated as implied-volatility convexity; GK>Parkinson read as directional trend
findings.why_it_matters: realized-vol measures say nothing about implied vol; GK-P is not a directional indicator — claims are unsupported
findings.correct_behavior: annotations limited to realized-vol statements; guardrails encoded in classify_regime and guidance rules

findings.existing_behavior: annotated to return a two-item tuple but returns five values
findings.why_it_matters: misleading API contract; callers unpacking per annotation crash
findings.correct_behavior: single dict return with named fields (Python) / typed interface (TS)

findings.why_it_matters: not a verified PSX convention for all instruments/dates; distorts sizing and cash constraints
findings.correct_behavior: whole-share sizing from price and cash (floor(budget/price)); no lot-size assumption

findings.why_it_matters: user's research configuration is PKR 100,000; hardcoded capital hides sensitivity
findings.correct_behavior: default PKR 100,000, fully configurable, sensitivity across 5/10/20/25% + equal-alloc sizing

findings.existing_behavior: no brokerage, PSX/NCCPL/CDC fees, taxes or slippage
findings.why_it_matters: gross returns presented as tradable results; PSX round-trip costs are material at retail scale
findings.correct_behavior: canonical V2 schedule ported exactly (0.03/share <=20 else 0.15%, PSX 0.00035% + NCCPL 0.00081% + CDC 0.0036% per side, zero synthetic slippage, CGT 15%/30% once per position)

findings.existing_behavior: fixed-size trades with only a simple cash check
findings.why_it_matters: no equity-proportional risk control; overconcentration ignored
findings.correct_behavior: equity-proportional and equal-alloc sizing, max-positions cap, cash-constrained, deterministic ordering

findings.existing_behavior: no proper separate daily account ledger
findings.why_it_matters: the user explicitly requires a daily account-level ledger with equity and drawdown per session
findings.correct_behavior: one portfolio row per session (even with no trade) with 18 fields incl. cash, invested, realized, unrealized, costs, equity, drawdown; saved as CSV and printed

findings.existing_behavior: unrealized and realized P&L not reconciled
findings.why_it_matters: MTM can silently masquerade as realized profit
findings.correct_behavior: identity enforced and tested: realized_net + unrealized(net of sunk entry costs) == final_equity - initial_capital; MTM never realized

findings.existing_behavior: incomplete metrics (no drawdown, PF, expectancy, exposure, turnover, streaks)
findings.correct_behavior: full metric set incl. ROI, CAGR (>=3y only), maxDD, win rate, avg win/loss, PF, expectancy, costs, exposure, turnover, longest loss streak
cash benchmark + cash-constrained equal-weight buy-and-hold over the identical window

findings.existing_behavior: stylized simulated prices used in the same pipeline as market analysis
findings.why_it_matters: simulated prices presented as market results would fabricate performance
findings.correct_behavior: synthetic data confined to software tests; all market conclusions from db/custom.db OhlcvBar
